basics.name: Chuks Clinton
basics.label: Penetration Tester | Web Application Security | Offensive Security
basics.summary: Penetration Tester with 3+ years of experience in application security testing, vulnerability assessment and software quality assurance. Background in web development and QA testing, providing strong understanding of web application architecture and security vulnerabilities. Experienced in vulnerability discovery through manual testing, Capture The Flag competitions and hands-on labs on TryHackMe, Hack The Box and PortSwigger Web Security Academy.

work.name: Stella Ops

Document findings with proof-of-concept steps, severity assessment, and remediation recommendations
Collaborate with developers to resolve vulnerabilities and improve secure coding practices
